title: C++ Templates
description: Function and class templates: how generic code is declared, deduced, specialised and instantiated. Covers non-type parameters, variadic templates, concepts, and why template code lives in headers.

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: 函式樣板與類別樣板：泛型程式碼如何宣告、推導、特化與具現化。涵蓋非型別參數、可變參數樣板、概念（concepts），以及為何樣板程式碼要放在標頭檔。

questions.prompt: Which keyword introduces a template declaration in C++?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 C++ 中，哪一個關鍵字用來引入樣板宣告？

explanation.zh-Hant: template 開始一個樣板宣告，參數列放在角括號內，例如 template <typename T> T twice(T v)。typename 或 class 只是用來宣告型別參數。

questions.explanation: template begins the declaration; the parameter list follows in angle brackets, for example template <typename T> T twice(T value). typename and class only introduce a type parameter inside that list.

questions.prompt: Given template <typename T> T maxOf(T a, T b); which call relies on template argument deduction?

prompt.zh-Hant: 已知 template <typename T> T maxOf(T a, T b);，下列哪一個呼叫依賴樣板引數推導？

explanation.zh-Hant: maxOf(3, 5) 由引數推導出 T = int。maxOf<int>(3, 5) 是明確指定、不靠推導；maxOf<int, int> 給了太多樣板引數；maxOf(3, 5.0) 對 T 推導出衝突的型別而失敗。

questions.explanation: maxOf(3, 5) lets the compiler deduce T = int from the two arguments. maxOf<int>(3, 5) names the argument explicitly, maxOf<int, int> passes more template arguments than the template declares, and maxOf(3, 5.0) deduces conflicting types for T and fails.

questions.prompt: Which of these can be partially specialised?

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪一項可以部分特化？

explanation.zh-Hant: 只有類別樣板（與變數樣板）可以部分特化。函式樣板只能全部特化，或改用多載；C++ 不允許函式樣板的部分特化。

questions.explanation: Only class templates (and variable templates) support partial specialisation. A function template may be fully specialised or simply overloaded, but the language has no partial specialisation for function templates.

questions.prompt: In `template <typename... Ts> void f(Ts... args);`, what is `Ts`?

prompt.zh-Hant: 在 `template <typename... Ts> void f(Ts... args);` 中，`Ts` 是甚麼？

explanation.zh-Hant: Ts 是樣板參數包；`Ts... args` 把它展開成函式參數包 args，sizeof...(Ts) 可取得引數數量。

questions.explanation: Ts is the template parameter pack; `Ts... args` expands it into the function parameter pack args, and sizeof...(Ts) yields the number of arguments.

questions.prompt: Which statements about template definitions and headers are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於樣板定義與標頭檔，下列哪些敘述正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 定義通常寫在標頭檔，讓每個編譯單元都能具現化。

b.zh-Hant: 編譯器在具現化點必須看得見完整定義。

c.zh-Hant: 在標頭留下宣告並在某個 .cpp 明確具現化，定義就可以放在該 .cpp。

d.zh-Hant: 樣板會像普通函式一樣只編譯一次並連結。

explanation.zh-Hant: 樣板在每個使用它的編譯單元各自具現化，因此定義必須可見。若在某個 .cpp 用 template class Foo<int>; 明確具現化，其他地方只需看到宣告。

options.text: The definition is usually placed in a header so every translation unit can instantiate it.
The compiler must see the complete definition at the point of instantiation.
A declaration in the header plus explicit instantiation in one .cpp file allows the definition to live in that .cpp file.
A template is compiled exactly once into a shared object and then linked like an ordinary function.

questions.explanation: Templates are instantiated separately in each translation unit that uses them, so the definition must be visible there. Explicit instantiation such as template class Foo<int>; lets one .cpp provide the generated code while other files only see the declaration.

questions.prompt: Which statements about C++20 concepts are correct? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於 C++20 的概念（concepts），下列哪些敘述正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 概念限制樣板可以接受哪些型別。

b.zh-Hant: 加上概念限制後，引數不符時通常能得到更清楚的診斷訊息。

c.zh-Hant: 概念在編譯期檢查，程式執行前就完成。

d.zh-Hant: 概念是每次呼叫時執行的執行期斷言。

explanation.zh-Hant: 概念是編譯期的具名限制，例如 template <std::integral T>；它不會產生執行期檢查，也不會取代樣板本身。

options.text: A concept restricts which types a template accepts.
A constrained template usually gives clearer diagnostics when an argument does not satisfy the constraint.
A concept is checked at compile time, before the program runs.
A concept is a runtime assertion evaluated on every call.

questions.explanation: Concepts are named compile-time constraints, for example template <std::integral T> T add(T a, T b). They add no runtime check, cost nothing at run time, and do not replace templates; they make template errors far easier to read.

questions.prompt: A non-type template parameter such as template <int N> may be supplied at run time by an ordinary function argument.

prompt.zh-Hant: 像 template <int N> 這樣的非型別樣板參數，可以由一般函式引數在執行期提供。

explanation.zh-Hant: 非型別樣板參數必須是編譯期常數運算式，例如 3 或 sizeof(int)；執行期才決定的值不能拿來具現化樣板。

questions.explanation: A non-type template argument must be a constant expression known at compile time, such as 3, sizeof(int) or a constexpr value. A value that only exists at run time cannot instantiate a template.

questions.prompt: A class template may declare several type parameters, for example template <typename K, typename V> class Map, and a full specialisation provides a complete definition for one exact argument list.

prompt.zh-Hant: 類別樣板可以宣告多個型別參數，例如 template <typename K, typename V> class Map；而全部特化會為某一組確切的引數提供完整定義。

explanation.zh-Hant: 類別樣板可以有多個型別參數，也可以有非型別參數；全部特化 template <> class Map<int, int> 就是為該組合另寫一份完整定義。

questions.explanation: Class templates accept any number of type and non-type parameters. A full specialisation such as template <> class Map<int, int> { ... }; replaces the whole definition for exactly that argument list.

questions.prompt: The C++17 expression that applies an operator across every element of a parameter pack is called a ____ expression.

prompt.zh-Hant: C++17 中把運算子套用到參數包每個元素的運算式稱為 ____ 運算式。

explanation.zh-Hant: 摺疊運算式例如 `(args + ...)`，會把參數包展開並以指定運算子合併。

questions.explanation: A fold expression such as `(args + ...)` expands a pack over an operator.

questions.prompt: In one or two sentences, explain why template definitions are usually placed in header files.

prompt.zh-Hant: 用一至兩句說明為何樣板的定義通常放在標頭檔。

model.zh-Hant: 因為編譯器必須看到完整定義，才能為每一組引數在該編譯單元具現化樣板，而每個編譯單元是各自獨立編譯的。把定義放在標頭檔可讓所有使用處都看得見；替代做法是在單一 .cpp 明確具現化，標頭只留宣告。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在於樣板不是先編譯成機器碼再連結，而是在使用處即時具現化，所以定義必須可見。

answer.model: The compiler must see the complete definition to instantiate the template for each set of arguments, and every translation unit is compiled independently. Putting the definition in a header makes it visible wherever the template is used; the alternative is explicit instantiation in one .cpp file with only a declaration in the header.

questions.explanation: Templates are not compiled ahead of time into a single object; they are instantiated where they are used, so the definition must be visible in every translation unit that instantiates them.
